info.title: k-vet API
info.description: Veterinary practice management — single user, self-hosted.

409.description: An invoice was written for one of its treatments

requestBody.description: multipart/form-data with a `file` part plus optional `kind`, `patient_id`, `patient_treatment_id`, `reference_date` and `note` parts

404.description: Unknown attachment or not an image

200.description: An empty draft, ready for auto-save

409.description: The drug already has an original packaging

parameters.description: Matches the invoice number or the customer's name.

409.description: No invoice is waiting for the bookkeeper

200.description: Accepted; the email is sent if SMTP accepts it

409.description: Only a created invoice can be accepted

200.description: Recorded as handed over on paper

409.description: Only a released, unsent invoice can be marked as posted
The invoice is not released, or is cancelled

500.description: The mail server rejected the message

409.description: Only a sent invoice can be submitted

parameters.name: empty
parameters.description: Include lots that are used up (default: only lots with stock).

Not an original packaging, or incomplete

200.description: An empty draft, ready for auto-save

parameters.name: species
parameters.description: Only the races recorded for this Tierart; absent means all of them.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term; empty returns the most-used entries.

parameters.name: hidden
parameters.description: Include hidden services (the surgical GOT positions, by default).

422.description: An address is malformed, or the logo does not exist

200.description: An empty draft, ready for auto-save

422.description: The treatment cannot be billed yet
A line does not belong to this treatment

recipient_emails.description: Customer email addresses the PDF is sent to.

AddressBookEntry.description: An address-book entry: a name and an optional postal address.

has_address.description: Database-generated: the address is complete enough to print.

patient_treatment_id.description:
The animal the group's lines are for. Absent means the treatment's only animal, and
with several it means none of them — which its drug lines will refuse.

starts_at.description: Minute-resolution start; the date defaults to today in the UI, the time is typed.

customer_id.description:
Whose visit this is. Chosen here and carried down to the treatments, which is what
limits the animals on offer to that customer's (FR-027).

customer_name.description: For the header, so the appointment says whose it is without a second request.

draft.description: `true` while mandatory fields are missing — excluded from billing flows.

missing_fields.description: Mandatory fields still empty, for the "incomplete — missing: …" hint.

unbilled_treatment_count.description:
Treatments here that carry positions and no live invoice — work that has not been
billed to anyone yet (FR-036).

AtRisk.description: One money-at-risk list: the oldest few cases, and how many there are in all.

treatment_id.description: Every case is resolved on the treatment page, so that is where a row leads.

date.description: The invoice's date, or the visit's while there is no invoice.

Attachment.description: Stored file metadata as returned by the API.

reference_date.description: Date the document refers to (patient files), independent of the upload time.

AttachmentKind.description: Who owns an attachment: a patient, a treatment, or a referencing record.

item_ids.description: The lines to remove. All of them must belong to the treatment in the path.

submitted.description: How many invoices were handed over.

invoice_numbers.description: Their numbers, so the vet can tick them off against the bookkeeper's list.

CreateCorrection.description: A stocktake: the vet states what is physically there, the server books the difference.

new_remaining.description: The counted remaining quantity. Defaults in the UI to the derived value.

includes_finding.description: Prints the treatment's finding on the invoice.

kind.description: `original` (bought and stocked) or `subset` (dispensed from the original).

customer_id.description: Pre-selects the owner when the patient is created from a customer page.

patient_ids.description:
Patients to attach right away; all must belong to one customer. Each gets its own
Patientenbehandlung.

patient_treatment_id.description: Defaults to the treatment's only Patientenbehandlung when there is exactly one.

redesignation.description: Ad-hoc Umwidmung; only meaningful on a drug line.

company.description: Optional company; printed above the name on the invoice, never instead of it.

oneOf.description: Optional second person of the household, addressed on the invoice as well.

home_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; null falls back to `[invoice] default_country`.

phone_display.description: The same number in the familiar national format, e.g. `030 12345678`.

invoice_missing_fields.description:
What an invoice would still be missing, evaluated on the address group it would actually
print (`invoice_*` when `has_invoice_address`, the home address otherwise).

Deliberately *not* the same set as `missing_fields`: a first name is not required to
record a customer, but an invoice without one is not one the practice wants to send.
Keeping it separate leaves the `customer_complete` CHECK — and therefore every existing
row — untouched. The country is never in this set: NULL means `[invoice] default_country`,
and it does not print on a domestic invoice anyway.

has_invoice_address.description: `true` when the invoice address group is complete and replaces the home address.

patient_names.description:
Living animals of this customer, alphabetical — what the customers list prints under
the name.

pending_invoice_count.description: Sent invoices not yet handed over to bookkeeping.

unbilled.description: Treatments that were worked and billed to nobody.

unsent.description:
Invoices released but never sent to the customer — including the ones whose email
failed on the way out, which is the case nothing used to show.

expiring_lots.description: The lots expiring soonest that still hold stock.

submission_receipt.description: Informational flags in this version — no reminders or ledgers (FR-012).

human_drug.description:
A medicine approved for humans, dispensed for use in an animal: priced by
§ 3 Abs. 1 Satz 2 AMPreisV rather than by the veterinary bands.

in_stock.description: Derived stock over the lots of the original packaging, in base units.

unit.description: The original packaging's unit — what `in_stock` is counted in.

original_price_gross.description:
Gross sales price of the original packaging — the figure the vet reads out to a customer
asking what something costs. `None` until that packaging has a price.

EmailType.description: Type of a customer email address.

remaining.description: Remaining base units, from the `lot_remaining` view.

FieldError.description: One field-level validation failure, as returned in `problem+json`.

field.description: Name of the offending field, in wire format (e.g. `home_zip`).

ts_sent_post.description: When the invoice was handed over on paper — the only trace a postal send leaves.

customer_name.description: Display name of the customer, for lists.

InvoiceStatus.description:
Invoice lifecycle: written, released, dispatched to the customer, handed to bookkeeping.
Dispatch is a precondition of the hand-off, which is what keeps one column sufficient.

packaging_quantity.description:
The packaging's size at the time of reading — what one package holds. The lot row
says "2 Packungen à 100 ml", which needs the size as well as the count.

initial_quantity.description: Snapshot of `packages × packaging quantity` at intake (FR-015).

Movement.description: One line of a lot's history — a dispense with its links, or a correction with a reason.

quantity.description: Signed: dispenses are negative, corrections either way.

reverses_movement_id.description: Set on the compensating correction of a cancelled invoice.

MovementKind.description: A stock movement is either a dispense tied to a treatment line or a correction.

currency.description: ISO 4217, used for every amount the app formats.

vat_rates.description:
The VAT rates a position may carry, in the order the operator listed them; the first
is what a new record starts on. Scaled like the `vat_percent` columns, so a rate can
be compared with a stored one as the string it is on the wire.

default_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, filled into a country field that has none.

version.description: The release this instance runs, from `KVET_VERSION` in the image; `dev` outside one.

environment_label.description:
Set on every instance that is not the practice's own, and drawn as a banner. `None` on
production.

list_price_net.description: Purchase price without VAT; derived pro rata for subsets.

sales_price_net.description: Sales price **without** VAT — the figure AMPreisV computes and the vet edits.

sales_price_gross.description: Derived from `sales_price_net`; what the customer pays.

price_overridden.description: `true` while the vet's manual price wins over the computed one.

computed_price_net.description: What AMPreisV would charge, net — shown next to an overridden price.

PackagingKind.description: Original packaging (bought, stocked) versus a subset dispensed from it.

list_price_net.description: Only meaningful for originals; subsets derive it pro rata.

sales_price_net.description: Setting this overrides the computed price; `null` returns to the computed one.

patient_treatment_id.description:
Moves the line to another animal, or out of all of them. It lands at the end of the
target's order; its dispensed lots follow, because they hang off the line.

customer_name.description: Customer name, so lists and pickers can show the owner.

weight_kg.description:
Weight in kilograms, one decimal. A single current value: each weighing replaces the
last, so there is no history.

PatientFile.description: Files a customer brought along, kept per patient with the date they refer to.

starts_at.description: The visit's date, for the page's heading — the record has no date of its own.

frozen.description: `true` once the treatment's invoice is accepted: the record reads read-only.

PatientTreatmentSummary.description: One visit this animal was part of, as the patient page lists them.

id.description: The `patient_treatment` record — what the list links to.

starts_at.description: The visit's date; the record has none of its own.

invoice_number.description: The visit's invoice, when it has one that was not cancelled.

name.description: Drug name; the UI composes the display label with locale formatting.

price_net.description: Net price, before the Steigerungssatz; `price_gross` is what the line will cost.

in_stock.description: Derived stock over all lots — a shortfall is visible before picking.

price_net.description: Net price, before the Steigerungssatz; `price_gross` is what the line will cost.

PickerItem.description: A pickable catalog entry — a tagged union so the UI can show distinct icons.

PriceMode.description: How a duplicate treats the prices pinned on the source's lines (FR-026).

basis_net.description: § 3(2) basis the surcharge is levied on.

rule.description: Which rule produced the price, for the hint next to the field.

list_price_net.description: Purchase price without VAT — of the original packaging in both cases.

original_quantity.description: Content of the original packaging (subset previews need it for the pro rata).

subset_quantity.description: Content of the subset being priced.

human_drug.description: A human preparation is priced by § 3 Abs. 1 Satz 2, not by the veterinary bands.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

errors.description: Field-level errors — present for validation failures.

Salutation.description: Form of address; `familie` addresses a household.

recipient_emails.description:
Where this send goes. Replaces the stored recipients, so a mistyped address can be
corrected and an invoice accepted without one can still be emailed.

got_number.description:
For a GOT position its own number; for a self-defined one the position it is charged
analogously to (§ 8 GOT), which is what marks it as such — there is no second flag.

net_price.description: The fee **without** VAT — the GOT publishes net, so that is what is stored and edited.

gross_price.description: Derived from `net_price` and `vat_percent` so the UI can show what the customer pays.

travel_expenses.description: Travel-expense lines are priced from the kilometres entered (FR-023).

hidden.description: Hidden services stay out of pickers and lists by default (FR-021).

ServiceType.description: Official fee schedule position versus a self-defined service.

authenticated.description: Whether the caller has a valid session.

username.description: Name of the logged-in user, when authenticated.

practice_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; empty falls back to `[invoice] default_country`.

email.description:
Shown in the invoice footer. The sender address of outgoing mail is operator
configuration and lives in `config.toml`.

cc_emails.description: Every outgoing invoice email is copied to these addresses.

name.description: Current catalog name — a template stores the reference, not a price.

TemplateItemKind.description: What a template line refers to.

patients.description: One record per animal, each with its own reason, finding and positions.

customer_id.description:
Whose visit this is, inherited from the appointment — the invoice's customer, and what
limits which animals may be attached (FR-027).

customer_emails.description: The customer's email addresses, offered as invoice recipients (FR-031).

oneOf.description:
The live invoice of this treatment, or the most recent cancelled one — the vet has
to see that the last attempt was cancelled, and can then bill again.

item_count.description:
How many positions are billed here. Zero means there is nothing to invoice yet, which
is what tells "still being written up" apart from "worked and never billed" (FR-036).

frozen.description: `true` once the invoice is accepted: lines and stock movements are frozen.

pdf_stale.description:
The treatment changed after its invoice PDF was rendered, so the document on file no
longer shows what is billed. The PDF is only ever written when an invoice is created.

patient_treatment_id.description:
The Patientenbehandlung this line belongs to, or null for a line that covers the
visit rather than one animal — the Wegegeld of a house call for two of them.

name.description: Copied from the catalog; the vet may override it per line.

factor.description: GOT factor in percent (100 = single rate).

got_analogous.description:
`true` when the number above is a position this line is only charged *analogously* to
(§ 8 GOT), rather than the line's own GOT position. Read from the service, like
`travel_expenses` — the number itself stays pinned, this only picks the label.

price_net.description: Per-unit **net** price, pinned at line entry.

price_gross.description:
The customer-facing unit price: gross, **with the Steigerungssatz already applied**.

This is the "Einzelpreis" of the invoice, and it has to be the figure that multiplies out
to the line total — the bare catalogue fee would not (a GOT position at Faktor 150 % would
print `28,11 € × 1 = 42,16 €`). Derived with `money::line_total` at quantity 1, so the
rounding matches `line_gross` exactly for a quantity of one; at larger quantities the
per-unit rounding may differ from `line_gross / quantity` by a cent, and `line_gross`
is the authoritative amount.

km.description: Travel-expense lines: the kilometres the price was computed from.

travel_expenses.description: `true` when the line's service bills travel expenses — the UI then asks for km.

redesignation.description:
Ad-hoc Umwidmung: this dispense is outside the preparation's approval — an eye
preparation used in an ear. Documentation only; it does not move the price.

line_gross.description: `line_net` plus VAT: what the customer pays for this line.

lots.description: Lots the dispense was booked against (drug lines).

TreatmentItemKind.description: What a billing line refers to.

id.description: The Patientenbehandlung — what positions and files hang on.
